content.title: What is the release date for Invincible season 4 episode 6 on Prime Video?
content.text: Stand ready to be hit with another episode of Invincible season 4, worms (Image credit: Amazon MGM Studios) Have you recovered from last week's episode of Invincible season 4? I hope so, because — spoilers notwithstanding — more brutal battles, melodrama, and the occasional bout of humor await in the Amazon TV Original's next chapter.I'm sure you're desperate to know when it'll be released, too, so let's cut to the chase: here's when you'll be able to stream Invincible season 4 episode 6 on Prime Video.What is the launch time for Invincible season 4 episode 6? Mark will be fine, right? RIGHT?! (Image credit: Amazon MGM Studios)Invincible's next entry, titled 'You Look Horrible', is set to drop on Wednesday, April 8. That's the same day that The Boys season 5 episodes 1 and 2 will launch on Prime Video, so comic book fans will have plenty of R-rated action to enjoy in less than 48 hours time.Article continues below As for the time that 'You Look Horrible' will air where you're based, read the list below (NB: viewers in Australia and New Zealand can stream it an hour earlier than previous entries because daylight savings time is no longer in effect):US — Wednesday, April 8 at 12am PT / 3am ETCanada — Wednesday, April 8 at 12am PT / 3am ETUK — Wednesday, April 8 at 8am GMTIndia — Wednesday, April 8 at 12:30pm ISTSingapore — Wednesday, April 8 at 3pm SGTAustralia — Wednesday, April 8 at 5pm AEDTNew Zealand — Wednesday, April 8 at 7pm NZDTHow many more episodes of Invincible season 4 can I look forward to? I wonder how many videogames Zoe and Allen have played... (Image credit: Amazon MGM Studios)After this week's installment, there'll only be two more to enjoy before Invincible season 4's time ends on one of the best streaming services. Barring any last-minute schedule changes, new episodes will continue to air on Wednesdays worldwide, too.Here are the important launch dates you need to know about for chapters 7 and 8:Invincible season 4 episode 1 — out nowInvincible season 4 episode 2 — out nowInvincible season 4 episode 3 — out nowInvincible season 4 episode 4 — out nowInvincible season 4 episode 5 — out nowInvincible season 4 episode 6 — Wednesday, April 8Invincible season 4 episode 7 — Wednesday, April 15Invincible season 4 episode 8 — Wednesday, April 22Follow TechRadar on Google News and add us as a preferred source to get our expert news, reviews, and opinion in your feeds.
